title: Questions
prompt: Create a 16:9 English closing slide for AEM training. Match the approved lesson-02 slide 07 style: warm off-white drafting-paper background, faint square grid, deep navy typography, thin technical rules, flat 2D repository-line illustration, restrained blue/violet/green/orange accents, no gradients, neon, glass, 3D, photography, watermark or unrelated logo. Render the eyebrow exactly as '09 · QUESTIONS', the title exactly as 'Questions', and only these three prompts: 'What is still unclear?', 'Which module boundary needs another example?', and 'What would you verify first?'. Use a large repository branch shaped like a question mark and three compact question rows. Keep the slide open and readable. Do not mention a demo, practice, command, assignment, acceptance criteria, evidence or next steps.

input_images.fidelity: Match style, palette, typography, density and technical precision only; do not copy the exact repository-map layout.

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: approved third sample prompt in the Codex conversation; detailed annotated repository map
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: Use the approved sample PNG as a style-only local reference; inspect it visually before generation.
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Subagents must use the same built-in image_gen backend in generate mode and return a blocker if unavailable.
